## Quick answer


**To edit a video with an AI text prompt, upload a short clip, ask for one specific visual change, state what must remain unchanged, and review the result across the whole shot.**


Prompt editing is best for changing what appears inside existing footage. Use a timeline editor when you need exact cuts, sequencing, captions or audio timing.


### Test one prompt-based edit


Upload a short rights-cleared clip and ask for one specific visual change. Review the beginning, middle and end before trying a second prompt.


[Edit a video free](https://magichour.ai/products/ai-video-editor)


Magic Hour publishes this guide and includes its own product in the comparison. Treat the recommendations as editorial guidance from a vendor, and verify the linked first-party product details and your own output requirements before choosing a tool.


## Prompt editing or timeline editing?


**Approach**


**How It Works**


**Best For**


**Timeline editing (CapCut, VEED)**


You manually arrange clips, trim footage, add effects, adjust audio, and work with layers on a timeline.


Full video production, multi-clip edits, precise timing, captions, transitions, and audio work.


[Prompt-based editing (Magic Hour)](https://magichour.ai/)


Upload an existing clip, describe the visual change in natural language, and let AI generate an edited version.


Quick object removal, background changes, visual restyles, color changes, added elements, and creative variations.


Choose by task. Prompt editing can remove, replace, add, recolor or restyle visual elements. Timeline editing assembles clips and controls timing. Many production workflows use both.


## A reliable prompt formula


Write four parts in this order: **target, change, preservation rules, finish** . Name the exact subject or region, describe one change, list the elements that must remain stable, then specify the intended lighting, texture or realism.


Template: \[Change\] the \[target\] in \[location\] to \[result\]. Keep \[subject identity, action, framing, camera movement and unaffected objects\] unchanged. Match the original \[lighting, perspective, shadows and texture\].


[Try in AI Video Editor](https://magichour.ai/create/ai-video-editor?prompt=Template%253A%2520%255BChange%255D%2520the%2520%255Btarget%255D%2520in%2520%255Blocation%255D%2520to%2520%255Bresult%255D.%2520Keep%2520%255Bsubject%2520identity%252C%2520action%252C%2520framing%252C%2520camera%2520movement%2520and%2520unaffected%2520objects%255D%2520unchanged.%2520Match%2520the%2520original%2520%255Blighting%252C%2520perspective%252C%2520shadows%2520and%2520texture%255D.)


## Six prompt recipes


-


**Remove:** Remove the person walking in the background on the right. Keep the main subject, camera movement, lighting and scenery unchanged. Reconstruct the occluded area naturally.


-


**Replace:** Replace the illuminated sign text with ‘Magic Hour.’ Preserve its shape, position, perspective, glow and reflections. Do not change the foreground subject.


-


**Restyle:** Restyle the clip as handmade clay animation. Preserve the subject's identity, action, framing and camera movement. Use soft studio lighting and visible clay texture.


-


**Recolor:** Change only the jacket from red to deep blue. Preserve material texture, folds, shadows, skin tones and every other color.


-


**Atmosphere:** Add light morning fog behind the subject. Keep the foreground sharp and preserve the original action, framing and exposure.


-


**Lighting:** Brighten the subject's face with soft window light. Preserve identity, background, camera movement and the scene's original color palette.

## How to edit a video with AI


### 1. Start with a controllable clip


Use rights-cleared footage with a clear subject, stable motion and consistent lighting. Fast cuts, heavy blur, large occlusions and multiple simultaneous changes are harder to preserve.


### 2. Upload and describe one change


Open[Magic Hour AI Video Editor](https://magichour.ai/products/ai-video-editor) , upload the clip and use the formula above. The current browser tool offers three free edits per day without sign-up; sign-in adds saved projects, account credits and more tools.


### 3. Generate and inspect the full shot


Check the first, middle and last frames, then watch at normal speed and frame by frame around the edited region. Inspect identity, geometry, text, hands, edges, shadows, reflections, background continuity and motion.


### 4. Refine the smallest failing instruction


If the output changes unrelated details, reduce the request to one target and add explicit preservation rules. If a precise local edit still fails, use a workflow with selection or masking controls instead of repeatedly broadening the prompt.


### 5. Finish the production workflow


After the visual edit passes review, use a timeline editor for exact trims, sound, captions and sequencing. Use[AI Video Extender](https://magichour.ai/products/ai-video-extender) to continue a shot or[AI Video Expander](https://magichour.ai/products/ai-video-expander) to generate new area around the existing frame.

## What vague prompts get wrong


-


**‘Make it better’ has no target.** Name the property to change and the desired result.


-


**‘Remove everything in the background’ is too broad.** Identify one object and describe how the revealed area should look.


-


**‘Make the subject cooler’ is subjective.** Specify lighting, wardrobe, palette, texture or another observable property.


-


**Several edits in one prompt compete.** Generate and approve one controlled change before the next.


## Pre-download quality check


-


**Continuity:** the change remains stable from beginning to end.


-


**Preservation:** identity, action, framing and protected objects remain recognizable.


-


**Integration:** edges, perspective, lighting, shadows and reflections fit the scene.


-


**Text and logos:** every visible character and brand mark is correct in every frame.


-


**Rights and disclosure:** source media, likenesses, marks and intended use are authorized; disclose material synthetic edits where required.
